EN:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}I'm glad YOU'RE here, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
I can't shake the feeling that
something weird is going on.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}At least I can count on you to
always be you. {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}So {{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}thanks,
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Menos mal que estás aquí,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} ¿No tienes la sensación
de que todo se ve un poco rarito?
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}No lo digo por ti. {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Tú estás
estupend{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}}, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Ah, {{TAG:0005:0008:}} ! Je suis vraiment
contente de te voir !{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} Quelque chose
ne tourne pas rond ici, tu sais...
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Au moins, maintenant que je sais
que tu es là, je suis rassurée.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} Oui,
ça va déjà mieux, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Ah, meno male che ci sei tu qui,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} Con tutte le cose strane
che stanno succedendo...
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}... so che almeno tu resterai sempre
te stess{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} Per questo {{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}ti ringrazio.
{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Gut, dass du da bist, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0008:}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Ich habe das Gefühl, hier ist etwas
sehr Seltsames im Gange.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Wenigstens kann ich mich auf dich
verlassen.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Danke, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}SENİN burada olmana sevindim, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
Bir şeylerin ters gittiği hissini
üzerimden atamıyorum.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}En azından senin her zaman kendin olacağına
güvenebilirim. {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}O yüzden {{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}teşekkürler,
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.

FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Euh... {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}On dit comment quand on est
dans un rêve ? {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}« Bonjour » ou alors
« bonne nuit » ?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Hmm, pas facile de s'y retrouver. Et
pourquoi pas « bonrêve »,
{{TAG:0005:0007:}} ?

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}It must be fate, {{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}the two of us
meeting here like this! {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}What else
could explain it, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}?
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Qué coincidencia encontrarnos 
aquí {{TAG:000E:0006:06006C006F00730006006C0061007300}} dos. {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}¡Será cosa del
destino, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}C'est étonnant de se rencontrer{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} en
plein rêve, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}nos esprits doivent être
connectés, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Oh! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Wir beide hier? {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}Das muss ein
Wink des Schicksals sein!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Anders
kann ich mir das nicht erklären!
